evals.prompt: We want to rebuild our whole billing system on a new provider; no idea where to start. Chart it.
evals.expected_output: Names destination with human, breadth-first fog, flags level-A areas in Notes, creates map + question tickets, wires blocking, stops.
expectations: Asks the human to confirm the destination before creating anything
Map Notes list likely level-A areas (e.g. payment/invoice lifecycle, provider webhooks)
Creates one map issue labelled wayfinder:map and child tickets phrased as questions
Wires blocking edges in a second pass using real ids
Stops after charting without resolving any ticket or writing product code

evals.prompt: Work the next decision on the billing map.
evals.expected_output: Loads map low-res, claims first frontier ticket, resolves by type (HITL waits for human), records resolution, one ticket only.
expectations: Claims (assigns) exactly one frontier ticket before working on it
Resolves it according to its wayfinder:<type> label; for HITL types waits for the human's answer
Posts a resolution comment, closes the ticket, adds one line to Decisions so far
Does not start a second non-research ticket in the same session

evals.prompt: Add a dark-mode toggle to settings. Use wayfinder.
evals.expected_output: Breadth pass finds no fog; stops and suggests spec instead of a map.
expectations: Does not create a map issue
Says the effort fits one session (no fog)
